outcome: preferences for the mode of delivery
cohort: The participants were women with twin pregnancies enrolled in the Twin Birth Study, an international, multi-center randomized controlled trial.
finding: Vaginal birth was preferred across all study groups and was associated with greater satisfaction with the childbirth experience.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth was preferred across all study groups and was associated with greater satisfaction with childbirth experience, while randomization for the mode of delivery was challenging for women due to the desire for involvement in decision-making.
